Page No.# 2/2 Call for the case diary.

I have heard the learned counsel of both sides in the matter of prayer for interim protection.

As an interim measure, it is hereby directed that in the event of arrest in connection with Jogighopa P.S. Case No.89/2024, registered under Sections 420/341/323/354/325/294/506 of the Indian Penal Code, the petitioners, namely- (1) Monowar Hussain and (2) Anowar Hussain shall be released on bail of 25,000/- with a surety of like amount to the satisfaction of arresting authority.
The petitioner is directed to appear before the Investigating Officer within next 10(ten) days and co-operate with police investigation.
